title: 加一个电压跟随器：两级不再互相拖累
summary: RC 低通 → LM358 电压跟随器 → RC 高通。跟随器把两级隔开：测中心频率处的增益，和上一个实验不加跟随器的结果对比。
concepts: 电压跟随器 voltage follower / buffer
输入阻抗高、输出阻抗低 high Z_in, low Z_out
级联网络函数相乘 H = H1·H2
description: 第一级 RC 低通（R1 10 kΩ、C1 15 nF）的中点接 LM358 的 IN+，OUT 直接接 IN−（跟随器），再推第二级 RC 高通（C2 15 nF、R2 10 kΩ）。信号发生器偏置 2 V，单电源 9 V。H = H_LP · H_HP = jx/(1 + jx)²。

cards.title: 两级中间插一个运放
text: 信号发生器：**`1061 Hz`、幅度 `1 V`、偏置 `2 V`**。和上一个实验比：输出离“两级相乘”的估计近了，还是远了？

cards.title: 跟随器：只看，不拿
text: - 跟随器的输入几乎**不取电流**：第一级的结点 A 感觉不到后面接了什么。
- 它的输出阻抗很低（约 10 Ω）：第二级看到的是一个“理想电压源”。
![](fig:follower)
- 于是两级可以**各算各的，再相乘**（令 x = f / f0，f0 = 1/(2πRC)）：
$$H = \frac{1}{1 + jx} · \frac{jx}{1 + jx}$$
动手之前代入 x = 1 算出 |H|，再和上一个实验的读数比一比。
- 为什么要 2 V 偏置：单电源 LM358 的输出不能低于 0 V。低通把偏置原样传给跟随器，它就在 1～3 V 之间摆动；C2 再把这 2 V 挡掉。

cards.title: 量跟随器两边
text: - **`1061 Hz`**：先把 **CH2 针尖挪到 `a10`**（跟随器的输出），读 OUT/VIN；再插回 **`e18`**（VOUT），读 VOUT/VIN。
- **万用表**红笔点 OUT（第 `10` 列），黑笔 GND：读平均电压。
- **`106 Hz`**：读 VOUT/VIN。

cards.title: 带走
text: - 级与级之间加**缓冲器**（电压跟随器），是“各级各算各的”的标准做法。代价：运放要供电，还要安排好直流偏置。
- 分母从 $1 − x^{2} + 3jx$ 变成 $(1 + jx)^{2} = 1 − x^{2} + 2jx$：少掉的那个 $jx$ 就是负载效应。
- 坑：真实 LM358 的压摆率约 0.3～0.5 V/µs、带宽约 1 MHz，仿真里没有这两个限制。1 V 幅度的信号到 50 kHz 以上，跟随器就跟不上了。

caption.text: 跟随器的等效电路：一个“复印” A 点电压的电压源。它只读 v_A，不从 A 取电流；第二级由它推动，碰不到第一级。

i18n.en: What the follower amounts to: a voltage source that copies the voltage at A. It only reads v_A and draws no current from A; it drives stage 2, which can no longer reach stage 1.

en.title: Add a voltage follower: two stages that no longer drag each other down
en.summary: RC low-pass → LM358 voltage follower → RC high-pass. The follower isolates the stages: measure the gain at the centre frequency and compare it with the previous experiment without the follower.
concepts: cascaded network functions multiply H = H1·H2
en.description: The midpoint of an RC low-pass (R1 10 kΩ, C1 15 nF) drives the LM358's IN+, OUT goes straight to IN− (a follower) and drives an RC high-pass (C2 15 nF, R2 10 kΩ). Generator offset 2 V, single 9 V supply. H = H_LP · H_HP = jx/(1 + jx)².
compare: - **1061 Hz**: the follower's output is 0.707∠−45°, VOUT = 0.707 × 0.707 = **0.5**∠0° (only 1/3 without the follower in the previous experiment). VOUT ≈ 1.0 Vpp.

Notice the denominator changed from "1 − x² + 3jx" to "(1 + jx)² = 1 − x² + 2jx": the missing jx is the loading effect. The follower's very high input impedance means node A doesn't feel stage 2 at all; its tiny output impedance (about 10 Ω) means stage 2 sees an ideal voltage source.

measurements.ask: 1061 Hz: CH2 tip on a10 (the follower output), amplitude ratio OUT/VIN
measurements.explain: The follower draws almost no current, so stage 1 is an unloaded RC low-pass: 0.707∠−45° at f0.

measurements.ask: 1061 Hz: CH2 back on e18 (VOUT), amplitude ratio VOUT/VIN
From your two readings, the gain of stage 2 (the high-pass) on its own = (VOUT/VIN) / (OUT/VIN)
measurements.explain: ≈ 0.707, exactly an unloaded RC high-pass at f0: the follower's output impedance is tiny, so stage 2 sees an ideal voltage source and the stages simply multiply.

measurements.ask: Multimeter DC range: the follower OUT to GND, the average
measurements.explain: The low-pass passes the 2 V offset unchanged, so the follower swings between 1 and 3 V, averaging 2 V; C2 then blocks it and VOUT averages 0.
H = jx/(1 + jx)², x = 0.1: |H| = 0.1/1.01 ≈ 0.099, phase ≈ +78.6° (0.097 and +73° without the follower).

hints: Power first: pin 8 to +9 V, pin 4 to GND; the follower is just a wire from OUT to IN−.
Stage 1 is R1 then C1 to GND, with its middle on IN+; stage 2 is C2 then R2 to GND, driven from OUT.
Keep the generator offset at 2 V so the follower never has to go below 0 V.
tests: 1061 Hz: VOUT is the product of the two network functions, phase 0°
1061 Hz: the follower output carries the DC offset, VOUT does not (C2 blocks it)

cards.title: An op-amp between the stages
text: The LM358 is already powered (pin 8 at +9 V, pin 4 at GND). Stage 1, a low-pass: **R1** (`10 kΩ`) **`b3`**–**`b12`**, **C1** (`15 nF`) **`c12`**–**`tn12`**. Column 12 is the op-amp's IN+.
The follower: one **jumper** **`b10`**–**`b11`**, joining OUT (column 10) to IN− (column 11).
Generator: **`1061 Hz`, amplitude `1 V`, offset `2 V`**. Compared with the previous experiment: is the output closer to the "multiply the two stages" guess, or further away?

cards.title: A follower looks but does not take
text: - A follower's input draws almost **no current**: node A of the first stage cannot tell what hangs behind it.
- Its output impedance is tiny (about 10 Ω): the second stage sees an "ideal voltage source".
![](fig:follower)
- So the two stages can be **worked out separately and multiplied** (let x = f / f0, f0 = 1/(2πRC)):
$$H = \frac{1}{1 + jx} · \frac{jx}{1 + jx}$$
Before you measure, put in x = 1 and work out |H|, then compare it with the previous experiment's reading.
- Why the 2 V offset: a single-supply LM358's output cannot go below 0 V. The low-pass passes the offset straight to the follower, which then swings between 1 and 3 V; C2 blocks those 2 V again.

cards.title: Measure both sides of the follower
text: - **`1061 Hz`**: first move the **CH2 tip to `a10`** (the follower's output) and read OUT/VIN; then put it back into **`e18`** (VOUT) and read VOUT/VIN.
- **Multimeter** red probe on OUT (column `10`), black on GND: read the average voltage.
- **`106 Hz`**: read VOUT/VIN.

cards.title: Take away
text: - A **buffer** (voltage follower) between stages is the standard way to let each stage be worked out on its own. The price: the op-amp needs power, and the DC bias needs planning.
- The denominator changed from $1 − x^{2} + 3jx$ to $(1 + jx)^{2} = 1 − x^{2} + 2jx$: the missing $jx$ is the loading effect.
- Pitfall: a real LM358's slew rate (about 0.3–0.5 V/µs) and bandwidth (about 1 MHz) are not simulated. A 1 V-amplitude signal above roughly 50 kHz is too fast for the follower to keep up.

tests.name: 1061 Hz：VOUT 等于两级网络函数的乘积，相位 0°
1061 Hz：跟随器输出带着直流偏置，VOUT 没有（C2 隔直）

compare: 注意分母从“1 − x² + 3jx”变成了“(1 + jx)² = 1 − x² + 2jx”：少掉的那个 jx 就是负载效应。跟随器的输入阻抗极高，第一级的 A 点不受第二级影响；输出阻抗很低（约 10 Ω），第二级看到的是一个“理想电压源”。

measurements.ask: 1061 Hz：CH2 针尖挪到 a10（跟随器输出），幅度比 OUT/VIN
measurements.explain: 跟随器几乎不取电流，第一级是不带负载的 RC 低通：在 f0 处 0.707∠−45°。

measurements.ask: 1061 Hz：CH2 插回 e18（VOUT），幅度比 VOUT/VIN
用你的两个读数算第二级（高通）单独的增益 = (VOUT/VIN) / (OUT/VIN)
measurements.explain: ≈ 0.707，正是一个不带负载的 RC 高通在 f0 处的值：跟随器的输出阻抗很低，第二级看到的是理想电压源，两级各算各的、直接相乘。

measurements.ask: 万用表直流档：跟随器 OUT 对 GND 的平均电压
measurements.explain: 低通把 2 V 偏置原样传过去，跟随器输出在 1 ~ 3 V 之间摆动，平均 2 V；C2 再把它挡掉，VOUT 的平均是 0。

hints: 先供电：8 脚 +9 V，4 脚 GND；跟随器就是一根从 OUT 到 IN− 的线。
第一级：R1 再 C1 到 GND，中点接 IN+；第二级：从 OUT 出发，C2 再 R2 到 GND。
信号发生器偏置保持 2 V，跟随器就不用输出低于 0 V 的电压。
